headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 26 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $48.5bn followed by Base and BSC. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume while Tether generated the top fees. USDT remains the largest stablecoin by circulating supply with minor daily outflows. Base leads L2 TVS at $14.9bn amid several recent security incidents.
